name: stem-trial-v01 round 2
status: frozen before D2b truth exists and before any RGB-D measurement was extracted

A_rendering.camera: camera 0, never used by GIC fitting; reference = rendered truth images
A_rendering.metric: PSNR over the reference foreground (non-white pixels) and full-frame PSNR, both after the GIC reader's own compositing (foreground on black); mean over frames
A_rendering.GIC_observed: native deformation-network render of its own fitting episode (D0; D1 per world), and native fixed-particle Gaussians driven by its simulated fitting trajectory
A_rendering.GIC_forecast: the same fixed-particle Gaussians (appearance trained on cameras 1-10 of the fitting episode only) driven by the sealed forecast particles
A_rendering.ours: our predicted displacement field rendered with the known rest mesh and texture by the trial renderer (supplied appearance; isolates motion error)
A_rendering.D2_status: D2 predictions were sealed before D2 truth; this rendering metric is added after D2 was opened, so D2 rendering scores are a post-hoc metric on sealed predictions

B_rgbd_sensing_for_ours.rgb: same rendered RGB images GIC receives (byte-identical), tracked frame-to-frame with OpenCV pyramidal Lucas-Kanade (21x21 window, 3 levels) from the projection of the known rest marker positions at frame 0
B_rgbd_sensing_for_ours.depth: rendered camera-space depth plus iid Gaussian noise sd 1.5 mm per pixel (seed 20261109 + episode/world), read as the 3x3 median at the tracked pixel, back-projected through the known camera
B_rgbd_sensing_for_ours.likelihood_sd: estimated once per world as the per-coordinate RMS residual of the best grid fit to D0, then fixed for D0 and D1 (plug-in empirical Bayes); residuals include tracking drift and surface sliding, which are not independent over time
B_rgbd_sensing_for_ours.label: RGB-D stratum; GIC remains on RGB only, its native input

C_prospective_D2b.load: gravity release + 25 N total along (0, -0.6, 0.8) (i.e. 15 N down, 20 N lateral) at the 0.75 L station [0.085, 0.115), same cosine ramp 0.25 s, 0.75 s, 48 fps
predictions_sealed: GIC simulator with true parameters (oracle control)
C_prospective_D2b.metrics: same physics metric as D2 plus part A rendering on camera 0
C_prospective_D2b.rule: freeze-v2 hashes written before D2b truth is generated
